name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: I want to be direct about where I stand on this role: my SEO background is technical audits, keyword gap analysis, and schema work, not hands-on Google Business Profile management or local-listings/citation work for enterprise brands specifically. What I do bring is closely adjacent, and I think it's worth a conversation.

At Solenzo, I run technical SEO audits and competitor research with Screaming Frog, implement schema and structured data, and built a 20+ workflow marketing-automation system for local service businesses that includes automated review-generation sequences, the reputation side of local SEO. Before that, at Birdeye, I onboarded 15-20 partners onto a reputation-management and local-marketing platform with roughly 94% retention, so I know that product category from the inside even though I wasn't the one running GBP optimizations myself. I also bring 15+ years of owning client relationships end to end: reporting, retention, and finding the next growth opportunity in an account, which is most of what this role asks for beyond the GBP mechanics.

I learn fast and I'm confident I could be productive on GBP-specific work quickly, but I'd rather say that plainly than let a resume imply experience I don't have. I'd welcome the chance to talk through how the rest of my background fits what you're building for your law firm clients.
